summary: Taoping Inc., a Nasdaq-listed Chinese smart-city/IoT software issuer, filed a 6-K disclosing an October 13, 2026 Nasdaq notification that its ordinary shares failed the US$1.00 minimum bid price rule after 30 consecutive business days below the threshold (August 31–October 12, 2026). Nasdaq granted a 180-day compliance period to April 12, 2027; a ten-day close at or below US$0.10 triggers delisting, and any reverse split must be effected at least ten business days before the deadline. No advisor or board recommendation was named, and the deficiency does not immediately affect listing or ticker TAOP. Watch for reverse-split authorization and a possible further 180-day grace period.
